title: BOS-1151 Home lists sessions from every organization

scenes.title: the board shows sessions from both organizations at once

steps.caption: The board has settled on the home session list

expect.text: Add rate limiting to public API
expect.label: a second Acme Corp session, in a different repo (my-api)
a Globex Industries session (my-web) — a DIFFERENT organization, on the same board
the REPO column distinguishes the rows by repo
and it carries a repo from the other organization
no ORGANIZATION column was added: the repo-origin index is unique, so REPO already answers which organization a row belongs to
the read is complete, so nothing claims the list is short

steps.caption: One board, four sessions, two organizations. Before this the remote read asked ProxyListSessions — which answers only the caller's ACTIVE organization — so the two Globex Industries rows were simply absent, and the sessions the list omitted could not be opened from the board at all.
